title: Material instructions for different channels

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Match delivery specifications to the destination so a finished video remains usable in its intended channel.
strategic_value: A channel comparison can reduce avoidable inconsistencies in Helsinki video handoffs.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture presents a table comparing Helsinki Channel, social-media delivery and raw footage across format, frame rate, bit rate, resolution and audio.
practical_value: Select the destination column before exporting and preserve channel-specific requirements rather than applying one preset everywhere.

content_islands.name: Delivery matrix
content_islands.spec: Keep the three destination columns aligned against the shared technical-property rows.

ingredient.name: Video delivery specification
ingredient.role: Keep the asset usable in its destination.
ingredient.application: Use the relevant table column; do not transfer raw-footage settings to channel delivery.
ingredient.scope: Published Helsinki guidance snapshot; Helsinki Channel lists 1920 × 1080, raw footage UHD 3840 × 2160. Values are source specifications, not independently updated technical advice.

reference_purposes.Application: The table maps export properties to three delivery contexts.
reference_purposes.Constraint: It specifies 25 fps and progressive scanning, while social resolution and aspect ratio follow the publication channel.
